attributes.action: Ensure Every Psychiatric Patient in Wales Receives a Hope Bag on Admission.
attributes.additional_details: People are often admitted to psychiatric wards unexpectedly, in crisis and without basic belongings. Hope Bags are essential care packs providing toiletries, hygiene products and comfort items to ensure that nobody enters psychiatric care without the basics needed to feel human, respected and cared for. Hope Bags improve patient experience, complement clinical care, reduce inequality in healthcare, support therapeutic relationships and allow staff to deliver quality care. Dignity is essential.
attributes.background: We want the Welsh Government to ensure every person admitted to a psychiatric ward in Wales receives a Hope Bag containing essential care items on admission, making Hope Bags a funded and standard part of psychiatric inpatient care in Wales. A mental health crisis shouldn't cost you your dignity.

rejection.details:
Your petition is about something that the Welsh Government and Welsh Parliament is responsible for. That means that the UK Government and Parliament can't look into it.

The Welsh Parliament has its own Petitions Committee. If you'd like to send your petition to the Welsh Parliament, you can find out more here: https://petitions.senedd.wales/

You may also wish to raise this issue with your local Members of the Senedd who represent you. You can find out who your Members of the Senedd are and how to contact them here: https://senedd.wales/find-a-member-of-the-senedd/
